run_evaluator_cli: run the evaluator CLI to compute FID, sFID, Inception Score, Precision, and Recall between reference and sample NPZ batches
compute_frechet_distance: compute the Frechet Inception Distance between two FIDStatistics objects with mean and covariance matrices
compute_inception_score: compute the Inception Score for a set of activations using softmax probabilities split into groups
compute_prec_recall: compute precision and recall metrics by comparing reference and sample feature manifolds using k-nearest neighbor radii
read_activations_from_npz: read image activations from an NPZ file and compute pool_3 and spatial features using the Inception V3 graph
